messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT - High 5xx rate detected for dedicated cluster 'nb-west-dedicated' serving customer NovusBank (customer_id: NB-721). 5m window breach (threshold 15%). Current 5xx: 23%. Incident ID INC-20260315-2475. Auto-paging primary on-call @Tom Oncall.

Tom Oncall: oncall here, ack. Severity: S2. I'm going to gather top traces and mute noisy alerts, please post any customer-facing text drafts.

Mike R: can someone confirm which routes are affected? frontend? embeddings? need endpoints list for customer note.

Sarah M: initial spike looks concentrated on text-generation endpoints for sequence lengths > 4096. Suspect KV cache eviction + worker restart loop. I'll check autoscaler and XLA worker logs.

Tom Oncall: running quick checks now — attaching grep of 502s from the gateway logs:
```
2026-03-15T14:12:10Z gateway nb-west-dedicated req=0xabc123 status=502 err="upstream read timeout"
2026-03-15T14:12:42Z gateway nb-west-dedicated req=0xabc456 status=502 err="worker terminated"
2026-03-15T14:13:05Z gateway nb-west-dedicated req=0xabc789 status=502 err="kv cache miss -> backend OOM"
```

Paul SE: I see repeated OOMs in model-worker-2 and model-worker-4. Possible bad quantization profile loaded? Rolling restart of affected pods + scale up should reduce 5xx while we investigate.

Sarah M: recommended mitigation steps: 1) scale pool by +2 GPUs, 2) cordon and restart model-worker-2/4, 3) pin model variant to non-quantized until we confirm. I'll run the commands.

Tom Oncall: doing step 1 and 2 now. Command: `redwoodctl cluster scale nb-west-dedicated --gpu +2`
```
> scaling started, target +2 gpus
> restarting pods model-worker-2, model-worker-4
```

incident-bot: status update: mitigation actions initiated for INC-20260315-2475. 5xx rate decreased to 14% (5m).

Kate CS: Need customer-facing impact statement for NovusBank and a routing list for account contacts. Novus execs want a single consolidated email and phone follow-up.

Tom Oncall: Draft for status page / customer email (please edit):
```
Short impact summary: From ~14:10 UTC to ongoing, NovusBank experienced elevated request failures (5xx) for model generation on their dedicated cluster in us-west-2. Root cause under investigation; initial mitigation (scaling and worker restarts) has reduced error rates.

Impact to NovusBank: Some generation requests returned 5xx or timed out. Customers using long-sequence requests (>4k tokens) were most affected. No data exposure suspected.

What we're doing: We scaled the dedicated pool, restarted affected worker nodes, and temporarily pinned the model to a fallback variant while we investigate a possible quantization-related memory regression. We will follow up with a post-incident summary and remediation plan.

ETA for normal operations: monitoring; expected lower error rates in 10-30 minutes while autoscaling completes.
```

Kate CS: routing/contact list for NovusBank (as requested by Sales/AM):
- Primary AM: Lina Morales <lina.morales@novusbank.com> / +1-415-555-0142
- Technical lead: Rajesh Patel <rpatel@novusbank.com> / +1-646-555-0199
- Security contact: secops@novusbank.com
- Legal/Compliance (cc-only): compliance@novusbank.com

Emily Comm: I'll prepare a tailored email using the draft. Proposed subject: "NovusBank: temporary generation failures on dedicated cluster (Mar 15)". Will send to primary AM + tech lead and post to status page. Anyone object?

Mike R: please include that we have no evidence of data exfiltration and that we're prioritizing customer workload stability. Also add a note about canary rollback if we find quantization regression.

Tom Oncall: 14:22UTC - 5xx now 9% and trending down. Workers restarted OK. Leaving pinned model variant in place. I'll keep monitoring and will hand off to overnight oncall at 14:35UTC.

Sarah M: capturing logs and creating a short postmortem checklist. Action items so far:
- [ ] Collect full heap dumps from model-worker-2/4 (Paul)
- [ ] Validate quantization profiles and run regression test on canary (Paul + Sarah)
- [ ] Post status page update + customer email (Emily)
- [ ] Follow-up call if error rate rises above 10% again (Tom)

Paul SE: grabbed heap dumps, pushing to secure bucket s3://redwood-incident-dumps/INC-20260315-2475. I'll start bisecting the quantization change set now.

Tom Oncall: handoff to night oncall @Sarah M at 14:35UTC — I'll update pagerduty and the incident timeline. Leaving pinned fallback variant and autoscaler adjustments in place.

incident-bot: NOTE - status page draft posted to /incidents/INC-20260315-2475.autodraft. Public visibility: restricted to NovusBank account until AM approval.

Kate CS: Emily, send email with this text, then ping Lina on Slack/phone. I'll be on standby for customer Qs.

Emily Comm: sending now to lina.morales@novusbank.com, rpatel@novusbank.com, secops@novusbank.com — subject line as above. Email content matches the draft. Will post an identical summary to status.redwood.com/INC-20260315-2475 in 2 minutes.

NovusBank Support: Thanks for the quick response. We'll coordinate internally and escalate if our production traffic does not stabilize in 30 minutes. Please keep us updated on root cause once available.

Tom Oncall: final note before handoff — if anyone pages the oncall overnight, prioritize rollback of the last quantization change (commit a1b2c3) as it has highest correlation.

Sarah M: acknowledged handoff. I have runbooks and the pinned variant. Will reopen channel if 5xx > 10% again.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-2475 status at 14:35UTC: mitigations applied, error rate 7%, monitoring. Active participants: Tom Oncall, Sarah M, Paul SE, Mike R, Kate CS, Emily Comm.

Tom Oncall: closing active paging for now. Will leave the incident thread open for PM/postmortem updates. Good work team. :thumbsup:
